summary: Tiger Muay Thai Chiang Mai is a Muay Thai training camp in San Sai, north of Chiang Mai, with onsite accommodation, a pool, a weight room and yoga classes.

facts.label: Accommodation
facts.value: Onsite accommodation for 20 or more guests
facts.quote: has accommodation for up to 20 or more quests, a swimming pool and weight-room

facts.label: Location
facts.value: San Sai, about 24 km north of Chiang Mai city and airport
facts.quote: approximately 24 kilometers north of the city and airport

facts.label: Levels
facts.quote: provides courses from beginner through advanced levels of Muay Thai

facts.label: Trainer certification

facts.quote: All Tiger Muay Thai Chiang Mai Trainers now certified by World Muay Thai Alliance Association

facts.label: Trainers
